title: Marketplace Publish Request
description: SSOT for the payload an author submits to LIST or UPDATE an artifact in the marketplace — the producer -> marketplace-service contract (the `molecule-plugin` SDK's `publish` verb emits it; a manual publish sends the same shape). It names the artifact by KIND + a pinned `gitea://<owner>/<repo>[/<subpath>]#<ref>` source, plus listing metadata (name/description/tags/visibility/tier/runtimes). Optional `attestation` is the provenance/signing hook (present-but-optional so unsigned publish works today; the server agent may require it later). Optional `pricing` is a DECLARATION of the seller's intended price — DATA ONLY: the marketplace agent's payment integration (Stripe/Connect/payouts — owner-gated) consumes it; this contract performs NO payment processing and carries NO Stripe fields. The artifact's full manifest is NOT duplicated here — the agent resolves it from `source` and validates it against the sibling manifest contracts (plugin-manifest/, workspace-template/, org-template/).

source.description: Pinned gitea source-contract string resolving to the immutable artifact ref being listed.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (derived from name if omitted).

runtimes.description: Runtimes the artifact targets (canonical hyphen form; underscore aliases accepted).

attestation.description: Optional provenance/signing block (the Phase-3 signing hook; unsigned publish is allowed today).

pricing.description: Optional price DECLARATION (data only; no payment processing in this contract).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key to dedupe a re-published request.

kind.description: Artifact kind. Same SSOT enum as catalog-entry.schema.json.

runtimeId.description: Canonical runtime identifier (hyphen form). Same SSOT enum as plugin-manifest.schema.json; underscore aliases accepted.

sourceRef.description: Pinned gitea source-contract string `gitea://<owner>/<repo>[/<subpath>]#<ref>` — `#<ref>` is a release tag or commit (human-facing). The marketplace agent RESOLVES it to an immutable commit SHA and records THAT resolved SHA in the install-request + entitlement (whose `source` is SHA-only).

attestation.description: Provenance/signing metadata for the published bundle. Optional — the server agent decides whether to require it.

mode.description: Signing mode. `none` = unsigned (allowed today); `keyless` = Sigstore/OIDC keyless; `keypair` = detached keypair signature.

digest.description: Lowercase sha256 (64 hex) of the published bundle.

signer.description: Signer identity (OIDC subject or key id).

allOf.description: A non-`none` attestation must carry real provenance — digest + signer + signature — otherwise it is a provenance-looking payload with no provenance.

pricing.description: DECLARATION of the seller's intended price. DATA ONLY — no Stripe/Connect fields, no payment processing. The owner-gated payment integration in the marketplace agent consumes this.

model.description: Pricing model. `free` = no charge; `one-time` = single purchase; `subscription` = recurring.

allOf.description: Paid models must declare a price and currency — a bare `{model: one-time|subscription}` is an incomplete declaration.
A subscription must declare its billing interval.
`free` carries no charge: no `interval`, and any `amount_cents` must be 0.
